<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=240,initial-scale=1">
<title>Golden creature</title>
<style>
html,body{margin:0;width:240px;height:294px;overflow:hidden;background:#fffcf7}
canvas{display:block;width:240px;height:294px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const renderer=new THREE.WebGLRenderer({preserveDrawingBuffer:true});
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(240,294,false);
renderer.outputColorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const scene=new THREE.Scene();
const ref=new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-120,120,147,-147,.1,1600);
ref.position.set(22,3,550);
ref.lookAt(22,3,0);

const V=(x=0,y=0,z=0)=>new THREE.Vector3(x,y,z);
const screen=(x,y,z)=>V(x-98,150-y,z);
const rest=(x,y,z)=>V(x-98,170-y,z-5.8);
function group(parent,name){
  const g=new THREE.Group();
  g.name=name;
  parent.add(g);
  return g;
}
const creature=group(scene,'Golden pear-shaped creature');
const characters=[creature];
const clamp=THREE.MathUtils.clamp;
const mix=THREE.MathUtils.lerp;
function smooth(a,b,x){
  const f=clamp((x-a)/(b-a),0,1);
  return f*f*(3-2*f);
}
const sq=x=>x*x;
const grain=`
  vec2 pix=floor(gl_FragCoord.xy);
  float checker=mod(pix.x+pix.y,2.)-.5;
  float weave=mod(pix.x+2.*pix.y,3.)-1.;
  float speck=fract(sin(dot(mod(pix,251.),vec2(12.9898,78.233)))*43758.5453)-.5;
  gl_FragColor.rgb+=checker*vec3(.050,.033,-.065)+weave*vec3(.022,-.015,.032)+speck*.034;
`;
const backdrop=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2,2),new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  depthWrite:false,depthTest:false,
  vertexShader:`varying vec2 p;void main(){p=uv;gl_Position=vec4(position.xy,.99999,1.);}`,
  fragmentShader:`varying vec2 p;
    float sq(float n){return n*n;}
    void main(){
      float y=1.-p.y,x=p.x;
      vec3 ivory=vec3(.999,.990,.982);
      vec3 sky=mix(vec3(.899,.912,.914),vec3(.914,.944,1.),smoothstep(0.,.17,y));
      sky+=vec3(.042,.025,-.010)*exp(-16.*sq(x-.48)-130.*sq(y-.046));
      sky-=vec3(.029,.018,0.)*exp(-2100.*sq(y-.194-.006*sin(8.*x)));
      vec3 c=mix(sky,ivory,smoothstep(.176,.254,y));
      c=mix(c,vec3(1.,.967,.897),smoothstep(.735,.854,y));
      c=mix(c,vec3(.663,.658,.653),smoothstep(.816,1.061,y));
      gl_FragColor=vec4(c,1.);
      ${grain}
    }`
}));
backdrop.name='Pale sky and distant ground';
backdrop.frustumCulled=false;
backdrop.renderOrder=-100;
scene.add(backdrop);

function material(properties){
  const m=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({roughness:.85,...properties});
  m.onBeforeCompile=shader=>{
    shader.fragmentShader=shader.fragmentShader.replace('#include <dithering_fragment>',
      '#include <dithering_fragment>\n'+grain);
  };
  return m;
}
const hide=material({vertexColors:true});
const solid=color=>material({color});

// Sections of the continuous head, torso and haunches in the starting pose.
const trunk=[
  [17.7,100,0,0,3],[19.5,100.5,8.9,8.1,3.6],
  [23,101.2,15.2,13.9,4.7],[29,101.6,19.1,18,5.5],
  [37,100.8,21.5,20,6.5],[46,99.7,23.4,22.1,7.2],
  [55,98.7,26.1,22.8,5.4],[65,96.8,29.4,24.3,2.9],
  [77,95.6,34.6,27.8,1.4],[92,95.4,37.1,31,1.3],
  [108,96.4,40.1,35.7,2.4],[126,97.4,47,42.4,4.1],
  [146,98.5,54.3,48.2,5.2],[164,98.7,58.2,50,5.8],
  [179,98.4,58,48.9,5.3],[192,98.3,54.5,45.4,4.3],
  [205,98.3,48.3,39.5,3],[216,98,37.5,31.4,1.7],
  [223,97.7,23.5,21.8,.5],[228,97.5,0,0,0]
];
const thighL=[
  [176,69,0,0,-1],[184,70,19,22,-1],[198,73.2,22.6,24.8,-1],
  [217,76.9,20.8,22.4,-1.4],[237,80.4,17.6,19.4,-1.7],
  [260,83.4,14.3,16.3,-1.3],[287,85.7,12.1,14.6,-.7],
  [301,86.6,11.3,14.9,.9],[308,86.1,12,17.1,3.8],[314,86,0,0,4]
];
const thighR=[
  [176,126,0,0,-3],[184,126.8,18,21,-3],[200,124.6,22.9,24,-3],
  [219,118.5,20.6,22,-3.2],[239,115.5,17.5,19.3,-3.2],
  [262,114.8,14.3,16.4,-3],[289,114.7,11.6,14.6,-2.6],
  [302,114.9,11.3,14.9,-1],[308,116,12.3,17,2.8],[314,116,0,0,3]
];
function section(rows,v){
  if(v<rows[0][0]||v>rows[rows.length-1][0])return null;
  let i=0;
  while(i+2<rows.length&&rows[i+1][0]<v)i++;
  const a=rows[i],b=rows[i+1],prev=rows[Math.max(0,i-1)],next=rows[Math.min(rows.length-1,i+2)];
  const d=b[0]-a[0],t=(v-a[0])/d,t2=t*t,t3=t2*t;
  return [1,2,3,4].map(k=>{
    const ma=(b[k]-prev[k])/(b[0]-prev[0]),mb=(next[k]-a[k])/(next[0]-a[0]);
    return (2*t3-3*t2+1)*a[k]+(t3-2*t2+t)*d*ma+(-2*t3+3*t2)*b[k]+(t3-t2)*d*mb;
  });
}
function ellipse(x,z,p){
  if(!p)return 120;
  const [cx,r,d,cz]=p;
  return (Math.sqrt(sq((x-cx)/Math.max(.012,r))+sq((z-cz)/Math.max(.012,d)))-1)
    *Math.max(.012,Math.min(r,d));
}
function meld(a,b,k){
  const h=Math.max(k-Math.abs(a-b),0)/k;
  return Math.min(a,b)-h*h*k*.25;
}
function front(x,v){
  const [cx,r,d,cz]=section(trunk,v);
  return cz+d*Math.sqrt(Math.max(.01,1-sq((x-cx)/r)));
}
const skinRGB=new THREE.Color();
function bodyColor(x,v,z){
  const rear=smooth(-12,26,z);
  const belly=Math.exp(-sq((x-100)/55)-sq((v-139)/37))*rear;
  const bib=Math.exp(-sq((x-102)/30)-sq((v-106)/23))*rear;
  const muzzle=Math.exp(-sq((x-102)/22)-sq((v-55)/13))*rear;
  const cap=Math.exp(-sq((v-23)/14));
  const leg=smooth(192,270,v);
  let r=mix(.97,.84,leg),g=mix(.723,.556,leg),b=mix(.148,.172,leg);
  g+=cap*.067-muzzle*.097;
  r=mix(r,1,belly*.9);g=mix(g,.778,belly*.93);b=mix(b,.616,belly*.96);
  r=mix(r,1,bib*.77);g=mix(g,.831,bib*.76);b=mix(b,.681,bib*.72);
  const shadow=(Math.exp(-sq((x-88)/6.6))+Math.exp(-sq((x-113)/6)))
    *Math.exp(-sq((v-39)/5.6))*rear;
  r-=.135*shadow;g-=.062*shadow;
  return skinRGB.setRGB(clamp(r,0,1),clamp(g,0,1),clamp(b,0,1),THREE.SRGBColorSpace);
}
function buildBody(){
  const step=2,nx=65,ny=153,nz=59,x0=34,v0=13,z0=-56;
  const slice=nx*ny,total=slice*nz;
  const values=new Float32Array(total),ids=new Int32Array(total);
  ids.fill(-1);
  for(let j=0;j<ny;j++){
    const sections=[trunk,thighL,thighR].map(rows=>section(rows,v0+j*step));
    for(let k=0;k<nz;k++)for(let i=0;i<nx;i++){
      const x=x0+i*step,z=z0+k*step;
      const a=ellipse(x,z,sections[0]),b=ellipse(x,z,sections[1]),c=ellipse(x,z,sections[2]);
      values[i+j*nx+k*slice]=meld(a,Math.min(b,c),10);
    }
  }
  const pos=[],col=[],ind=[],weights=[],bones=[];
  const off=[0,1,nx,nx+1,slice,slice+1,slice+nx,slice+nx+1];
  const edges=[[0,1],[2,3],[4,5],[6,7],[0,2],[1,3],[4,6],[5,7],[0,4],[1,5],[2,6],[3,7]];
  for(let k=0;k<nz-1;k++)for(let j=0;j<ny-1;j++)for(let i=0;i<nx-1;i++){
    const n=i+j*nx+k*slice,inside=values[n]<0;
    if(off.every(o=>(values[n+o]<0)===inside))continue;
    let sx=0,sy=0,sz=0,count=0;
    for(const [a,b] of edges){
      const fa=values[n+off[a]],fb=values[n+off[b]];
      if((fa<0)===(fb<0))continue;
      const u=fa/(fa-fb);
      sx+=mix(a&1,b&1,u);sy+=mix((a>>1)&1,(b>>1)&1,u);sz+=mix(a>>2,b>>2,u);count++;
    }
    const x=x0+(i+sx/count)*step,v=v0+(j+sy/count)*step,z=z0+(k+sz/count)*step;
    ids[n]=pos.length/3;pos.push(x-98,170-v,z-5.8);
    const cc=bodyColor(x,v,z);col.push(cc.r,cc.g,cc.b);
    const hw=1-smooth(57,155,v),lw=smooth(187,232,v);
    bones.push(0,1,x<98?2:3,0);weights.push(1-hw-lw,hw,lw,0);
  }
  function quad(n,a,b,reverse){
    const p=ids[n],q=ids[n-a],r=ids[n-a-b],s=ids[n-b];
    if(Math.min(p,q,r,s)<0)return;
    if(reverse)ind.push(p,r,q,p,s,r);else ind.push(p,q,r,p,r,s);
  }
  for(let k=1;k<nz-1;k++)for(let j=1;j<ny-1;j++)for(let i=1;i<nx-1;i++){
    const n=i+j*nx+k*slice,inside=values[n]<0;
    if(inside!==(values[n+1]<0))quad(n,nx,slice,inside);
    if(inside!==(values[n+nx]<0))quad(n,slice,1,inside);
    if(inside!==(values[n+slice]<0))quad(n,1,nx,inside);
  }
  const g=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  g.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos,3));
  g.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(col,3));
  g.setAttribute('skinIndex',new THREE.Uint16BufferAttribute(bones,4));
  g.setAttribute('skinWeight',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(weights,4));
  g.setIndex(ind);
  g.computeVertexNormals();
  return g;
}
const body=new THREE.SkinnedMesh(buildBody(),hide);
body.name='Continuous golden hide';
body.frustumCulled=false;
creature.add(body);
function joint(parent,name,p){
  const b=new THREE.Bone();b.name=name;b.position.copy(p);parent.add(b);return b;
}
const pelvis=joint(body,'Torso and pelvis',V());
const neckRest=rest(99,65,3);
const head=joint(pelvis,'Head and neck',neckRest);
const legL=joint(pelvis,'Leg left',rest(73,199,-1));
const legR=joint(pelvis,'Leg right',rest(124,199,-3));
body.bind(new THREE.Skeleton([pelvis,head,legL,legR]));

const sphere=new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,24,16);
function oval(parent,name,p,radii,mat){
  const m=new THREE.Mesh(sphere,mat);
  m.name=name;m.position.copy(p);m.scale.set(...radii);parent.add(m);return m;
}
function gradient(stops,u){
  let i=0;
  while(i+2<stops.length&&u>stops[i+1][0])i++;
  return new THREE.Color(stops[i][1]).lerp(new THREE.Color(stops[i+1][1]),
    smooth(stops[i][0],stops[i+1][0],u));
}

// Updateable elliptical tube with a smoothly transported radial frame.
function tube(parent,name,points,radii,mat,stops=null,depth=1,rings=24,sides=16){
  const geo=new THREE.BufferGeometry(),pos=new Float32Array((rings+1)*sides*3);
  const index=[],colors=[];
  for(let i=0;i<=rings;i++){
    const c=stops?gradient(stops,i/rings):null;
    for(let k=0;k<sides;k++){
      if(c)colors.push(c.r,c.g,c.b);
      if(i<rings){
        const l=i*sides+k,n=i*sides+(k+1)%sides;
        index.push(l,n,l+sides,n,n+sides,l+sides);
      }
    }
  }
  for(let k=1;k<sides-1;k++)index.push(0,k+1,k,rings*sides,rings*sides+k,rings*sides+k+1);
  geo.setIndex(index);
  geo.setAttribute('position',new THREE.BufferAttribute(pos,3));
  if(stops)geo.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors,3));
  function shape(pts,rs){
    const path=new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(pts,false,'centripetal');
    let a;
    const b=V(),p=V(),t=V();
    for(let i=0;i<=rings;i++){
      const u=i/rings;
      path.getPoint(u,p);path.getTangent(u,t).normalize();
      if(i===0){
        a=V().crossVectors(t,Math.abs(t.z)<.95?V(0,0,1):V(1,0,0)).normalize();
      }else{
        a.addScaledVector(t,-a.dot(t)).normalize();
      }
      b.crossVectors(t,a).normalize();
      const f=u*(rs.length-1),j=Math.min(Math.floor(f),rs.length-2);
      const r=mix(rs[j],rs[j+1],f-j);
      for(let k=0;k<sides;k++){
        const theta=2*Math.PI*k/sides,ac=r*Math.cos(theta),bc=r*depth*Math.sin(theta);
        const l=(i*sides+k)*3;
        pos[l]=p.x+a.x*ac+b.x*bc;pos[l+1]=p.y+a.y*ac+b.y*bc;pos[l+2]=p.z+a.z*ac+b.z*bc;
      }
    }
    geo.attributes.position.needsUpdate=true;
    geo.computeVertexNormals();geo.computeBoundingSphere();geo.computeBoundingBox();
  }
  shape(points,radii);
  const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(geo,mat);mesh.name=name;parent.add(mesh);
  return {mesh,shape};
}
const facePoint=(x,y,offset)=>rest(x,y,front(x,y)+offset).sub(neckRest);
const eyes=group(head,'Eyes');
const eyeParts=[];
const lidMat=solid(0xcaa53d),creaseMat=solid(0x897328),socketMat=solid(0xb6a644);
const eyeMat=material({color:0x111809,roughness:.5});
const glintMat=solid(0x8e9850);
for(const [side,x,y] of [['left',86.4,38.6],['right',114.2,38.0]]){
  const eye=group(eyes,'Eye '+side);
  const shut=group(eye,'Lowered eyelid');
  const shutX=side==='left'?90.6:113.5;
  const tilt=(shutX-100)*.043;
  oval(shut,'Rounded ochre lid',facePoint(shutX,y,-.75),[4.8,3.1,1.8],lidMat).rotation.y=tilt;
  tube(shut,'Closed lid crease',[[-3.4,.15],[-1.5,.85],[.7,.91],[2.9,.39]].map(
    ([dx,dy])=>facePoint(shutX+dx,y+dy,.84)),[.14,.54,.56,.1],creaseMat,null,.83,12,10);
  const open=group(eye,'Open eye');
  open.position.copy(facePoint(x,y,.05));
  open.rotation.y=(x-100)*.040;
  oval(open,'Olive socket',V(0,.1,-.48),[4.9,5.5,2.0],socketMat);
  oval(open,'Dark eye',V(0,0,.7),[3.65,4.25,2.7],eyeMat);
  oval(open,'Reflection',V(-.91,1.52,3.07),[.56,.59,.24],glintMat);

}
const mouth=group(head,'Muzzle and mouth');
oval(mouth,'Soft upper lip',facePoint(102.2,47.5,-1.47),[9.9,3.4,2.1],solid(0xe8af39)).rotation.y=.1;
const lipXs=[91.8,96.0,101.8,107.5,113.1];
function lipPoints(expression,lower=false){
  return lipXs.map((x,i)=>{
    const n=Math.abs(i-2)/2;
    const y=mix(48.0,50.45,1-n*n)-expression*(1-n*n)*4.1+expression*n*1.2+(lower?1.23:0);
    return facePoint(x,y,.42+(1-n*n)*(lower?.45:1.05));
  });
}
const rim=[.12,.71,.96,.73,.12],lowerRim=[.08,.42,.52,.43,.08];
const smile=tube(mouth,'Mouth line',lipPoints(0),rim,solid(0x73531e),null,.75,22,12);
const lowerLip=tube(mouth,'Lower lip',lipPoints(0,true),lowerRim,solid(0xd99a31),null,.8,22,12);

// A palm has its own wrist frame. Each digit bends independently from its knuckle.
const palmStops=[[0,0x716032],[.52,0x584a31],[1,0x4a422f]];
const digitStops=[[0,0x50452f],[.67,0x49422e],[1,0x857755]];
function makeHand(parent,side){
  const hand=group(parent,'Hand '+side),digits=[];
  tube(hand,'Palm',[V(0,-2,0),V(0,2,0),V(0,7,.4),V(0,11,.6),V(0,12.5,.65)],
    [3.25,4.05,5.05,4.55,2.75],hide,palmStops,.74,20);
  const mirror=side==='left'?1:-1;
  const ends=[21.8,25.6,25.0,22.4];
  for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
    const x=(i-1.5)*2.63;
    const finger=group(hand,'Finger '+(i+1));
    finger.position.set(x,9.4,.45);
    const end=ends[i]-9.4;
    tube(finger,'Tapered digit',[V(),V(x*.105,4,.22),V(x*.25,end-4,.81),
      V(x*.29,end-1.25,1.65),V(x*.28,end,2.02)],
      [1.58,1.71,1.36,.86,.19],hide,digitStops,.91,18,12);
    digits.push(finger);
  }
  const thumb=group(hand,'Thumb');
  thumb.position.set(2.65*mirror,3,1.2);
  tube(thumb,'Thumb pad and tip',[V(),V(1.3*mirror,3.9,1.2),V(2.55*mirror,9,1.96),
    V(3.22*mirror,13.2,2.6),V(3.05*mirror,14.5,3.14)],
    [2.04,2.02,1.61,1.02,.25],hide,digitStops,.95,18,12);
  return {hand,digits,thumb,mirror};
}
const armStops=[[0,0xf2ba2b],[.30,0xf6c134],[.57,0xedb736],[.76,0xd8a735],[.89,0xac8930],[1,0x66562d]];
const restRadii=[4.2,10.1,9.1,6.25,4.6,4.0,3.7,3.55];
const raisedRadii=[4.7,11.4,11.6,10.2,10.1,8.15,5.55,4.05];
function makeArm(side){

const arms=[makeArm('left'),makeArm('right')];

// Belly center, width, height, depth, body turn, crown position, head turn,
// eye opening, mouth curvature and the swing of the two legs.
const times=[0,800,1530,2330,3130,3930,4670,5470];
const poses=[
  [98,170,1,1,1,0,100,0,0,0,0,0],
  [68,181,1.005,.918,1.04,.17,78,.085,1,.06,-.11,.008],
  [91,178,.99,.981,1.05,.025,90,-.015,1,-.20,.075,.14],
  [109,197,1.448,1.405,1.39,-.048,115,-.025,1,1.14,-.042,.06],

// Shoulder, elbow, wrist and the direction to the middle fingertip in view space.

const leftTrack=[
  [72.5,67,-6.8, 53.7,119,-1.8, 37.2,189.2,7.2, 31.7,214,11, 0,0,.06,0],
  [48,88,3, 54,134,36, 77,92,59, 102,77,63, -.54,.25,.18,1],
  [63,81,2, 51,146,29, 54,121,62, 46,93,71, -.17,.25,.60,1],
  [65,57,-15, 42,138,-9, 21,196,0, -8,211,7, .42,.22,.23,.44],
  [58,68,4, 58,148,38, 67,118,67, 65,91,81, -.28,.02,1.0,1],

  [105,73,-29, 100,143,-36, 121,204,-30, 134,228,-23, .81,.15,.1,.22]

const rightTrack=[
  [121.2,67,-7.8, 140.1,120,-4.8, 158.8,194.3,4.2, 164.0,220,7.2, 0,0,.06,0],
  [93,88,0, 108,113,36, 106,90,55, 93,70,63, .48,.64,.21,.98],
  [115,80,0, 147,133,18, 169,130,35, 190,136,45, .46,.72,.13,.96],
  [149,57,-13, 168,140,-12, 181,206,-3, 191,231,2, -.45,.36,.14,.32],
  [124,68,-7, 147,140,-7, 161,202,0, 172,233,7, .08,.05,.18,.14],
  [126,75,20, 64,106,40, 46,62,46, 49,39,51, .43,.75,.13,1],
  [137,82,21, 66,119,43, 40,83,49, 36,63,58, .35,.73,.11,1],
  [109,77,19, 127,152,37, 152,214,43, 170,238,50, -.59,.16,.37,.47]
];

function sample(track,i,f){
  const a=track[i],b=track[Math.min(i+1,track.length-1)];
  if(f===0||i===track.length-1)return a;
  const prev=track[Math.max(0,i-1)],next=track[Math.min(track.length-1,i+2)];
  const t2=f*f,t3=t2*f;
  return a.map((v,k)=>{
    const change=b[k]-v;
    // Limit tangents at gesture reversals so the hand lands on its mark.
    const slope=(u,w)=>u*w<=0?0:2*u*w/(u+w);
    const da=i===0?0:slope(v-prev[k],change);
    const db=i+2>=track.length?0:slope(change,next[k]-b[k]);
    return v+(3*t2-2*t3)*change+(t3-2*t2+f)*da+(t3-t2)*db;
  });
}
const inv=new THREE.Matrix4(),basis=new THREE.Matrix4();
const axisZ=V(0,0,1);
function animateArm(part,data,bodyScale){
  const localAt=j=>screen(data[j],data[j+1],data[j+2]).applyMatrix4(inv);
  const shoulder=localAt(0),elbow=localAt(3),wrist=localAt(6),tip=localAt(9);
  const [roll,curl,spread,raised]=data.slice(12);
  const p=(a,b,f)=>a.clone().lerp(b,f);
  const shoulderCap=p(shoulder,elbow,.19);
  shoulderCap.x+=(part.mirror===1?-1:1)*2.2;
  const upper=p(shoulder,elbow,.55);
  const elbowIn=p(shoulder,elbow,.89),elbowOut=p(elbow,wrist,.13);
  const points=[shoulder,shoulderCap,upper,elbowIn,elbow,elbowOut,p(elbow,wrist,.61),wrist];
  part.limb.shape(points,restRadii.map((r,i)=>mix(r,raisedRadii[i],raised)));
  part.hand.position.copy(wrist);
  const direction=tip.sub(wrist);
  const length=direction.length();
  const y=direction.normalize();
  const cameraAxis=axisZ.clone().applyQuaternion(creature.quaternion.clone().invert());
  const x=V().crossVectors(y,cameraAxis).normalize().applyAxisAngle(y,roll);
  const z=V().crossVectors(x,y).normalize();
  part.hand.quaternion.setFromRotationMatrix(basis.makeBasis(x,y,z));
  const reach=length/(25.4-.85*curl);
  const width=(1+.24*raised+.11*spread)*clamp(reach,.89,1.26);
  part.hand.scale.set(width,reach,width);
  for(let j=0;j<4;j++){
    const finger=part.digits[j];
    finger.rotation.set(-curl*(.82+.12*j),0,-(j-1.5)*.225*spread);
  }
  part.thumb.rotation.set(-.31*curl,0,-part.mirror*(.18+.75*spread));
}

scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfff9e9,0xd5aa87,1.58));
function light(name,color,intensity,x,y,z){
  const l=new THREE.DirectionalLight(color,intensity);
  l.name=name;l.position.set(x,y,z);scene.add(l);
}
light('Broad warm daylight',0xfff7de,1.55,-120,215,175);
light('Peach reflected light',0xffdfd2,.61,146,62,95);
light('Soft skylight on back',0xfff0cb,1.03,25,124,-150);

function render(t){
  const ms=((t%5540)+5540)%5540;
  let i=0;
  while(i+1<times.length&&times[i+1]<=ms)i++;
  const f=i===times.length-1?0:(ms-times[i])/(times[i+1]-times[i]);
  const [cx,cy,sx,sy,sz,yaw,crownX,headYaw,opening,expression,ls,rs]=sample(poses,i,f);
  creature.position.copy(screen(cx,cy,0));
  creature.rotation.y=yaw;
  creature.scale.set(sx,sy,sz);
  creature.updateMatrixWorld(true);
  inv.copy(creature.matrixWorld).invert();

  const crown=rest(100,17.7,3).applyMatrix4(creature.matrixWorld);
  const dx=crownX-98-crown.x;
  head.position.copy(neckRest);
  head.position.x+=dx*Math.cos(yaw)/sx;
  head.position.z+=dx*Math.sin(yaw)/sz;
  head.rotation.y=headYaw;
  const swingAxis=V(-Math.sin(yaw),0,Math.cos(yaw));
  legL.quaternion.setFromAxisAngle(swingAxis,ls);
  legR.quaternion.setFromAxisAngle(swingAxis,rs);

  for(const {shut,open} of eyeParts){
    shut.visible=opening<.49;
    open.visible=opening>.018;
    open.scale.y=Math.max(.018,opening);
  }
  smile.shape(lipPoints(expression),rim);
  lowerLip.shape(lipPoints(expression,true),lowerRim);
  animateArm(arms[0],sample(leftTrack,i,f),sx);
  animateArm(arms[1],sample(rightTrack,i,f),sx);
  renderer.render(scene,ref);
}
window.nwb={scene,renderer,cameras:{ref},characters,render,ready:true};
render(0);
</script>
